run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a python function and print average execution time in milliseconds
test_time_func_warmup: test time_func warmup runs 5 iterations before timing to ensure accurate benchmark results
review_time_func_perf_counter: review time_func to understand how it uses perf_counter for high-resolution timing measurements
summarize_time_func_api: summarize time_func which takes a callable, iterations count, and optional name for benchmarking
refactor_time_func_iterations: refactor time_func to customize the number of iterations for more precise benchmarking
